trace.answer_for_eval:
For enrollment, you need the following documents:

1. 2 pcs 2x2 ID picture
2. Original Certificate of Transfer (for transferees only)
3. Clearance (for old students)
4. Enrolment Slip from Admission Office (for new students/transferees)
5. Original Form 137 (for new students only)
6. Original Certificate of Good Moral Character
7. 1 pc. long brown envelope
8. Medical slip/Certificate from LSPU Medical Clinic
9. Photocopy of PSA Birth Certificate / Marriage Contract (for married female students)
10. Original Report Card (for new students only)
11. Student ID (for old students)
12. Transcript of Records / Copy of Grades for evaluation purposes (for transferees only)
